_comment: A pocket watch -- a KEY ITEM. Carrying it lets the pilgrim READ the hour off a notebook entry; the moment itself is always recorded, because the world's time runs whether or not he can tell it (has(satchel,'watch') gates the hour on the dateline, never the record; see docs/design/NOTEBOOK.md + WorldClock.h). Found, not started with -- until then a note shows only which day of the walk it came on.
name: Pocket Watch
description: A small brass watch, still ticking. It tells you when.
